[[File:Reward casket (elite) detail.png|left|130px]]
A '''[[reward casket]] (elite)''' is received after completing the final clue of an [[Clue scroll (elite)|elite clue scroll]] trail, and contains the final reward for the trail. Opening the reward casket is required for treasure trail completion to be tracked on the [[HiScores]] and [[collection log]].

The player can possess unlimited amounts of reward caskets up to the [[Stackable_items#Limit_of_a_stack|stack limit]]. Players are eligible to receive more clue scrolls regardless of how many reward caskets are in the player's posession.

==Rewards==
Elite clues generate a minimum of 4 rewards and a maximum of 6, granting an average of 5 rewards per casket. The rewards consist of generic items, shared treasure trail items, and items that are unique for elite clues. Additionally, players have a 1/5 chance to receive a [[master clue scroll]] upon opening an elite casket - this does not take up one of the 4-6 reward slots.

There is also a 1/35 chance of the reward casket being a [[mimic]], which can be taken to the [[strange casket]] in [[Watson]]'s house to fight [[The Mimic]]. Players are only eligible to receive mimics if they have spoken to the strange casket to enable the chance of a reward casket turning into a mimic. If a player attempts to open an elite reward casket for the first time before speaking to the strange casket, they will be asked whether they want a chance of a Mimic boss fight or not, and wanting it will result in the chatbox directing players to the strange casket. If you do not enable the mimic boss fight BEFORE opening any clue scrolls, it will VOID your chance at a mimic chest. 

All droprates (except for the [[Mimic]] rewards) are confirmed by Mod Tide.{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Tide|url=https://twitter.com/JagexTide/status/1131933683714330624|date=24 May 2019|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/106558|archivedate=24 May 2019|quote=I know its been a while since the clue expansion but here is the information on clue scroll drop rates and loot chances! If anything changes I will keep you posted.|name=Clue rates tweet}}{{CiteGeneral|url=https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/16pVNHdZyynmxIbM9mynRDYT0LQsWxq-vbDs4_7DpnGM/edit?usp=sharing|title=Clue scrolls 2019|author=|time=24 May 2019}} The listed rarities are per roll.

On average, it will take 8132 reward caskets to obtain all the unique drops specific to elite clues (not including drops shared by other clue tiers). This includes two of the mega-rares (the [[Ring of nature]] and [[Lava dragon mask]]) since they are unique to the elite reward casket, unlike the other mega-rares.

The average loot roll is worth {{Coins|{{EliteClueValue}}}} and average elite clues are worth {{Coins|5 * {{EliteClueValue}}}}, without considering the value from potential master clues. The 1/5 chance of receiving a master clue scroll adds another {{Coins|1/5 * 6 * {{MasterClueValue}}}}, for a total expected value per clue of {{Coins|5 * {{EliteClueValue}} + 1/5 * 6 * {{MasterClueValue}}}}.

The Mimic has a significantly boosted chance to reward a piece of 3rd age equipment, adding an expected value of {{Coins|floor(1/35*{{EliteMimicValue}})}} for a total of {{Coins|5 * {{EliteClueValue}} + 1/35*{{EliteMimicValue}}}} per elite reward casket, or {{Coins|5*{{EliteClueValue}} + 1/35 * {{EliteMimicValue}} + (1/5)*(6*{{MasterClueValue}} + 1/15*{{MasterMimicValue}})}} when including the master clue and subsequent master Mimic chance.

====Mimic rewards====
''Main article: {{Section|The Mimic|Elite drops}}''

When enabled, players have a 1/35 chance to find a [[mimic]] casket upon opening their reward casket. Bonus loot is occasionally received as an extra reward when opening the mimic casket, in addition to the regular 4-6 clue scroll rolls.

The quantities received depend on how many attempts it took to kill the Mimic. Each failure reduces the quantity by 1/5 of the maximum.

{{DropsLineReward|name=Major elite scroll case|quantity=1|rarity=Always|leagueRegion=No|raritynotes=<ref group="d">Players will always receive a [[major elite scroll case]] on their 150th completed elite clue scroll ''or'' their first completed elite clue scroll if their clue count is above 150 (if the player has lost the item and did not open it before).</ref>|gemw=No}}
{{DropsLineReward|name=Heavy casket|quantity=1|rarity=always|raritynotes=<ref group="d">Players will always receive a [[heavy casket]] on their 200th completed elite clue scroll ''or'' their first completed elite clue scroll if their clue count is above 200 (if the player has lost the item).</ref>|gemw=No}}

==Changes==
{{Subject changes header}}
{{Subject changes
|change = Changed the rarity of 3rd Age items from Elite Clues to fit proportionally between Hard and Master Clues.
|date = 11 May 2022
|update = Equipment Rebalance Tier Changes & Poll 76
|poll = Old School Content Poll 76: Game Improvements
}}
{{Subject changes
|date = 15 August 2019
|update = Small Game Updates and Betas
|poll = Old School Content Poll 68: Small Game Improvements
|change = The locks on the reward casket have been changed to reflect the tier of Treasure Trail it comes from.
}}
{{Subject changes
|date = 11 April 2019
|type = hotfix
|change = The chance of an elite reward casket being a mimic was changed from 1/80 to 1/35.{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Wolf|url=https://twitter.com/JagexWolf/status/1116299462870274048|date=11 April 2019|archiveurl=https://archive.is/pudqn|archivedate=29 May 2020|quote=We will be changing the rate of the Mimic chance after a discussion with the team and your feedback that it may be a tad too rare. We will be keeping an eye on the frequency over the coming days, but these are the new rates which will be live shortly: Master: 1/15 Elite: 1/35}}
}}
{{Subject changes
|date = 11 April 2019
|update = Treasure Trails Expansion and Easter 2019
|poll = Old School Content Poll 65: Treasure Trails Expansion
|change = All Treasure Trails caskets were changed to be stackable.
}}
{{Subject changes
|date = 6 July 2016
|update = Treasure Trail Expansion (2016)
|poll = Old School Content Poll 42: Clue Scrolls Expansion
|change = All of the lower tier clues are getting many new additions to the drop tables.
}}
{{Subject changes
|date = 3 July 2014
|update = Halos, God Books & Stamina
|change = Extended antifire potions rewarded from elite treasure trails are now noted.
}}
{{Subject changes
|date = 26 June 2014
|update = Midsummer Event
|poll = Old School feature poll - Rewarding Rewards
|change = The [[Rangers' tunic]] are now available as a reward from elite reward caskets.
}}
{{Subject changes
|date = 12 June 2014
|update = Treasure Trail Expansion
|poll = Old School feature poll 19
|change = There are over 180 new items available to be discovered by solving clue scrolls including third age weaponry, new outfits and a host of other items. There are new rewards and brand new clues for every level of treasure trail.
}}
